simple.meaning: בִּצָּה (bitstsâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a swamp.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בִּצָּה (H1207) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 8:11, with occurrences in Job, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בִּצָּה (H1207) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בִּצָּה (H1207) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בִּצָּה (bitstsâh) / H1207 is traced through Job 8:11, Job 40:21, Ezekiel 47:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
